bind_displays.description: Pick the number entity that moves this display, and optionally the light entity for its indicator LED.

data_description.min_update_interval: Rapid source updates are coalesced to at most one write per interval, which spares a mechanical movement.
data_description.fade: With blending off, the LED switches colour sharply at each stop.

preset.title: Preset {index}
preset.description: A preset is a scene across the whole device: it decides what every display shows at once.

preset_assign.title: {preset}: {display}
preset_assign.description: Choose what {display} shows under the {preset} preset. Leave the source empty to leave this display unused.

data_description.min_value: Calibration belongs to the preset, so the same display can cover a different range under each preset.
data_description.source_mode: Live entities push updates. Statistics are polled, and need the recorder.

preset_done.title: Preset saved
preset_done.description: Add another preset, or finish setting up this device.

wizard.title: Board
wizard.description: Pick your board. The wizard only offers pins that are safe to use, and never touches the flash or strapping pins.

displays_hw.title: Display {index} wiring
displays_hw.description: Which GPIO drives display {index}, and does it have an indicator LED?

leds_hw.title: Display {index} LED
leds_hw.description: Wiring for the indicator LED on display {index}. Several displays may share one addressable data pin.

buttons_hw.title: Button {index}
buttons_hw.description: Which GPIO reads button {index}? Leave it empty to finish. Buttons are global to the device, not tied to one display.

data.multi_click: Detect single, double and long presses

source_unavailable.title: {display} has lost its source
source_unavailable.description:
The {preset} preset points {display} on {device} at `{entity_id}`, which is unavailable, unknown or not numeric. The display is holding its last reading rather than dropping to zero.

Check that the entity still exists and that the integration providing it is loaded. This issue clears itself as soon as the source produces a value again.
